richiami.difetto: It is possible that during the manufacturing test of the Hand Brake Valve that damage occurred to the handle locker.  It is then feasible that the handle locker could come to rest in an unsecured position which could subsequently allow the handle to move to the released/drive position and result in a vehicle roll-away.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all effected unit and check for damage. If found to be damaged replace the hand brake valve with a new quality assured item.
richiami.titolo: VEHICLE MAY ROLL AWAY

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that under intensive operational conditions the driver's seat mechanism can wear and allow the seat to collapse.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the driver's seat exchanged.
richiami.titolo: DRIVER'S SEAT MAY COLLAPSE SHOULD THE ADJUSTING MECHANISM BE SUBJECT TO WEAR.

richiami.difetto: The air brake system has been incorrectly piped. Normally the system will function correctly but if a rear brake reservoir pipe should fail the front brakes may also become ineffective.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and interchange two brake pipe connections.
richiami.titolo: AIR BRAKE SYSTEM INCORRECTLY PIPED.

richiami.difetto: The handbrake pivot lever within the brake drum may break across the pivot hole.  This will cause the parking brake to fail on the affected side.
richiami.rimedio: Modify the parking brake mechanism within the brake drum.
richiami.titolo: PARKING BRAKE EFFICIENCY

richiami.difetto: The air compressor mounting bracket may fracture and cause the drive belt to break. This will ultimately result in a lack of air pressure to operate the braking and suspension systems.
richiami.rimedio: Fit a strengthened air  compressor support bracket.
richiami.titolo: AIR COMPRESSOR MOUNTING BRACKET MAY FRACTURE.

richiami.difetto: Emergency exit door lock operating bar could become distorted and inoperative in exceptional circumstances such as in a collision or as a result of vandalism.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and fit an additional support bracket to the lock operating bar.
richiami.titolo: EMERGENCY EXIT DOOR LOCK OPERATING BAR CONCERN

richiami.difetto: Steering box mounting bracket cracked. Possible detachment of box could occur if the crack worsens.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected vehicles and replace any cracked mounting brackets. Further investigations are being carried out with the chassis manufacturer to determine whether the original bracket design requires modification.
richiami.titolo: STEERING BOX MOUNTING BRACKET MAY CRACK
